csv_project_name: CMAR for Parks Shop, Firehouse & Water Maintenance Building
csv_scope_of_work: Construction Manager at Risk services for 1) Parks Shop Building : Scope includes the demolition of a storage building to the south of the PSB and the construction, site work, and utility work associated with a new 6,000 square foot standalone building located in close proximity to the existing PSB. Work will also include some renovations of the existing building. Project to be completed prior to relocation of Firehouse operations 2) Water Maintenance Shop Addition: Scope includes construction, site work, and utility work associated with an approximately 6,000 square-foot building addition on the east side of the existing building 3) Cherry Street Firehouse (Firehouse): Scope includes temporary relocation of the North Liberty Fire Department to the completed Water Maintenance Shop Addition prior to the demolition of the existing single story fire station building and associated storage shed onsite. The scope also includes construction of a two-story fire station with approximately 27,000 square feet and the associated site and utility work. A component to consider with firehouse construction is a rated storm shelter of approximately 1,500 square feet included in the firehouse footprint.
